Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mrs. Pratima Kumari, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Satendra Narayan Singh, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 05-05-2025 Heard the learned Advocate for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner happens to be husband of O.P. No. 2 apprehends his arrest in connection with Halsi P.S. Case No. 113 of 2024, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 341,
323 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the O.P. No. 2 on 19.11.2022 as per the Muslim custom.
However, on account of some differences between the parties, arising out of a family feud, the present FIR has been instituted.

It is specifically submitted that the petitioner has always been Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.26152 of 2025(2) dt.05-05-2025 ready to keep the O.P.
No. 2 as his wife with full honour and dignity, but on account of some reason unknown to the petitioner, the O.P. No. 2 left the petitioner and filed a Maintenance Case bearing No. 46 of 2024,
which is also pending consideration.
The mother of the petitioner had also lodged a complaint case against the O.P. No. 2 and her family members.

4. Let notice be issued to the O.P. No. 2 under both processes i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of two weeks, from Mohammad Akhlak Mallick vs The State Of Bihar on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146999862/
1 today.
